text:
mira.s: vendor (red-labs) wants to include a limited prod auth-bypass exercise next Wed 10:00-12:00 UTC. we need decision: allow limited prod scope or emulate?

dimitri.r: strongly prefer emulate. we can create a mirrored service in staging with same auth surface. avoids live-data exposure.

red-labs rep (via email): would like to decrypt one sample payload to validate exploit chain. they requested kms:Decrypt against our key.

mira.s: no direct kms:Decrypt on prod key. proposal: create a synthetic key + synthetic ciphertext that mirrors real key metadata. vendor can run Decrypt against synthetic key only.

sam.oncall: agree. i'll provision a synthetic key with kms:Decrypt allowed for the assessor principal in readroom only, TTL 2h. will add S3 prefix for evidence uploads.

taylor.security: must log every Decrypt call and preserve CloudTrail entries in evidence bucket. redact any PII before we hand over. also require assessor to sign data-handling addendum.

legal.liaison: will circulate a short addendum (NDA addendum + data handling) tonight. nothing released until signed.

jenna.reports: creating tracker entry now. tracker fields: label=pentest/2026-06, triage_owner, evidence_bucket, synthetic_kms_key_arn, legal_signed=true/false.

mira.s: runbook owners: provisioning = dimitri.r; runbook + revocation = sam.oncall; triage intake = jenna.reports; legal = legal.liaison.

dimitri.r: quick note on policy: ephemeral grant will include kms:Decrypt and s3:PutObject to readroom. sample policy snippet I'll paste in runbook:

```json
{
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","s3:PutObject"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:...:synthetic-key","arn:aws:s3:::pentest-readroom/*"],
  "Effect": "Allow"
}
```

sam.oncall: dry-run tonight 20:00 UTC to validate synthetic decrypt flow + readroom pipeline. invite sent. please join if you touch KMS or logging.

pt-bot: PEN-TEST: vendor red-labs scheduled 2026-06-03T10:00Z. assessor keys uploaded to handshake repo.

jenna.reports: vendor has requested 2 retest slots: 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-17, prefer afternoon US time. i'll mark tentative and loop vendor.

taylor.security: post-window checklist: 1) revoke grants, 2) rotate proxy creds, 3) rotate synthetic key and remove ciphertext, 4) export CloudTrail snapshot to evidence_bucket, 5) run log-redaction job.

mira.s: timeline check: RBAC snapshot 24h before, legal sign-off before any key provisioning, dry-run 24h before, main window, then retest cadence weekly x2.

legal.liaison: signed addendum received from red-labs? vendor returned signed PDF. uploading to tracker.

dimitri.r: synthetic key ARN -> arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/synt-pentest-2026-06. will bake policy and post in runbook.

sam.oncall: after main window i'll rotate any service-account tokens used for the proxy and post evidence of revocation.

mira.s: final: no live prompt or customer data in readroom. any sample data must be synthetic. if vendor requests escalation to prod, we'll deny and document rationale. ping me immediately on any deviations. :warning:

jenna.reports: tracker link -> https://redwood-internal/triage/pentest-2026-06. initial ticket created PT-4521.

sam.oncall: dry-run reminder 20:00 UTC. small checklist in thread: create synthetic ciphertext, provision key, run decrypt via assessor key, upload CloudTrail snapshot.

dimitri.r: copying checklist and starting work now.

mira.s: thanks all. we'll close loop after dry-run and confirm final scope in tracker.
